title: Nervura Brasil Home Page Redesign
promptTitle: Title: Nervura Brasil Shopping Cart Page
prompt:
Title: Nervura Brasil Shopping Cart Page
Context: E-commerce shopping cart page for a Brazilian women's fashion brand focusing on quality and cultural identity.
Description of the screen: A clean and sophisticated shopping cart page. The layout features a main section on the left listing the added products (image, name, size, quantity selector, and price) in a minimalist table format with thin separators. On the right, a 'Resumo do Pedido' (Order Summary) sidebar with a light cream background, showing the subtotal, shipping calculation field, and the total price in a bold font. Below the total, a prominent 'Finalizar Compra' button in golden-yellow. The footer and header remain consistent with the homepage design. The interface is spacious, high-end, and easy to navigate.
Platform: web
Form factor: desktop
